observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tinutukoy ang pangangailangan at pagkaapurahan, pinipili ang angkop na contact sa loob ng saklaw, at ipinapaliwanag ang pagtitiyak at follow-up nang hindi inaantala ang agarang tulong.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Identifies need and urgency, chooses an appropriate contact within scope, and explains verification and follow-up without delaying immediate help.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa naitutugma ang contact sa pangangailangan o ipinagpapaliban ang agarang tulong.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Does not yet match the contact to the need or delays immediate help.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Malayang naitutugma ang pangangailangan, contact, pagtitiyak at follow-up; pinananatili ang propesyonal na hangganan at agarang tulong.
levels.kaya_na_en: Independently matches need, contact, verification and follow-up; maintains professional boundaries and timely help.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng tanong upang linawin ang saklaw, alternatibong contact o follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Direction is appropriate but prompting is needed to clarify scope, an alternative contact or follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi angkop ang contact o hakbang, nangangako ng hindi kumpirmadong suporta, o pinaghihintay ang agarang tulong.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Contact or action is inappropriate, promises unconfirmed support, or makes immediate help wait.
